name: Amanoi
insider_take: Amanoi is a clifftop sanctuary where dramatic granite peaks meet pristine coastline in Vietnam's hidden Vinh Hy Bay – a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve that feels like your own private slice of paradise.
whats_special: This ultra-exclusive Aman resort features just 31 pavilions scattered across 200 hectares of untouched wilderness. Each villa offers sweeping views of the South China Sea from private infinity pools. The property sits within Nui Chua National Park, making it one of the few luxury resorts completely integrated into a protected natural environment.
pro_tip: Book the Lake Pavilions for the most secluded experience – they're positioned around a tranquil lotus pond and offer complete privacy with dedicated beach access via the resort's vintage Land Rover fleet.
dont_miss: The resort's private beach at Vinh Hy Bay, accessible only by boat or a scenic trek through the national park. The bay's coral reefs offer some of Vietnam's best snorkeling, while the nearby fishing village of Vinh Hy provides authentic cultural encounters that most travelers never discover.
pros: Stunning clifftop location overlooking Vinh Hy Bay
Exceptional spa treatments and wellness facilities
Luxurious pavilions with private pools and ocean views
World-class service and attention to detail
cons: Remote location requires longer travel time
